title: Refunds and Fees Callbacks: The Wait for the Personal Sender Account Statement
content:
**Rule.** For a callback on refunds and fees to a Personal Sender Account holder, the wait for the statement is the number of calendar days from the callback request date to the delivery due date of the account's most recent statement request. When it is 14 days or more, 2 business days are added to the counted fees callback window; when it is at least 7 but fewer than 14 days, 1 business day is added to the counted fees callback window; when it is fewer than 7 days, or that delivery due date is on or before the callback request date, nothing is added for the wait for the statement.

## The record read

The account's statement requests appear on its account history, each with the date it was requested and its delivery due date. The most recent statement request is the one requested last, and its delivery due date is counted against the callback request date in calendar days, weekends and holidays included.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Delivery due date of the most recent statement request | Calendar days ahead | Business days added |
|---|---|---|
| 14 or more days after the callback request date | 14 or more | 2 |
| 13 days after | 13 | 1 |
| 7 days after | 7 | 1 |
| 6 days after | 6 | 0 |
| on the callback request date or before it | 0 or fewer | 0 |

## Hypothetical example

A callback on refunds and fees is requested on a Tuesday, and the most recent statement request on the account has a delivery due date on the Friday of the same week: 3 calendar days ahead, fewer than 7, so nothing is added. Had that delivery due date fallen on the Tuesday of the following week (7 calendar days ahead), 1 business day would be added.
